apps.title: Evidence And Cause Workbench
apps.role: Practice separating observations, baselines, candidate causes, stochastic mechanisms, value claims, model boundaries, and justified causal claims.
apps.description: A foundational empirical-reasoning tool for learning how biological explanations move from measured patterns to cautious causal inference.

provenance.summary: New evo-edu foundational reasoning app connected to Notebook empirical reasoning needs.
provenance.details: This app was added to make explicit the empirical program behind the Notebook sequence: observe a phenomenon, compare against a baseline, consider stochastic and multi-cause alternatives, separate progress or value claims from empirical claims, evaluate magnitude, and flag exercise simplifications before assigning causation.
lineage: Futuyma 1979 progress/value, chance/mechanism, and simple-model/multi-cause Notebook guardrails
Supports Hardy-Weinberg Workbench planning and later mechanism apps
limits: The workbench uses simplified toy scenarios rather than full statistical inference.
The magnitude explorer is qualitative and intended for reasoning about sufficiency, not parameter estimation.
Real-world causal analysis requires stronger design, replication, uncertainty estimates, and domain-specific measurement.

provenance.summary: Modern JavaScript adaptation of an older GA-based TSP solver lineage, wrapped in evo-edu public documentation.
provenance.details: Route Optimizer is built on a JavaScript and HTML implementation of a genetic-algorithm Traveling Salesperson solver. The implementation notes in the underlying tool cite Hiroaki Sengoku's GA-based TSP work as an important algorithmic influence, and the current version was produced as a modern browser replacement for earlier Java applet-era examples that were no longer usable. The evo-edu route adds public documentation, study guidance, and curriculum context around that implementation.
lineage: Algorithmic lineage noted in the implementation: Hiroaki Sengoku's GA-based TSP solver work
limits: The underlying implementation is strong, but its public documentation was sparse before this remediation pass.
Known issue noted in the implementation: manual city-definition click accuracy still needs improvement.
